# bun audit high-severity allowlist
#
# `.github/workflows/ci.yml`'s `audit` job runs:
#   bun audit --audit-level=high $(this file, one --ignore=<GHSA-id> per line)
# Any HIGH or CRITICAL advisory NOT listed below fails CI immediately.
#
# Every line here is a temporary, individually-justified exception for a
# finding that existed on the date it was added — not a blanket suppression.
# Do NOT add an entry without a justification, and do NOT bump the date on
# review without re-verifying the reasoning still holds.
#
# Each entry must state: the advisory, the dependency path, why no fix is
# adoptable, why it is not exploitable in this codebase's usage, and a
# tracking issue. "Upgrading is inconvenient" is not a reason. An entry with
# no stated reason is indistinguishable from suppressing a real finding.
#
# ⚠️ An advisory's range can be EXTENDED after publication, which silently
# re-vulnerablises an `overrides` floor that was set to the then-fixed
# version (#1581: `seroval: ">=1.6.0"` against a later `<= 1.6.0` range was
# pinning the vulnerable version). Verify target versions against the
# upstream advisory's `first_patched_version`, never against a changelog or
# a recommendation (#632) — and never bump past an advisory's range when the
# new version does not actually contain the fix (see http-cache-semantics
# below for a live example of exactly that trap).
#
# Review cadence: re-audit and prune stale entries whenever a listed
# package is intentionally upgraded, and at least quarterly otherwise.
# Follow-up tracking issue: https://github.com/Llamenos-Hotline/llamenos-platform/issues/649
#
# Format: GHSA-id  # added YYYY-MM-DD by <who> — package — reachability — reasoning

# --- extract-zip: webdriverio browser-download path — NO UPSTREAM FIX ---
# Re-verified 2026-10-09: both advisories cover `<= 2.0.1` with
# first_patched_version=null on the GitHub advisory, and npm `latest` IS
# 2.0.1 — the newest release is the vulnerable one, so no floor can be
# written. The only path in is webdriverio 9's `@puppeteer/browsers@^2.2.0`;
# webdriverio 10 moves to `@puppeteer/browsers@^3.2.1` which replaced
# extract-zip with modern-tar, removing the path entirely. That upgrade is a
# breaking test-harness major (Node >=22.19, Appium 3, Mocha 12, removed
# commands) and is tracked in #1769.
# Reachability: webdriverio's browser/driver download unzip path (desktop E2E
# tooling, no CI coverage). The symlink traversal needs an attacker-supplied
# archive; the only archives extracted here are browser binaries fetched over
# HTTPS from Chrome for Testing. Dev/test tooling, never in a request path.
GHSA-jmr9-qjv8-65gv  # added 2026-09-11, re-justified 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo, re-verified 2026-10-09 by fix-649-audit (fleet) — extract-zip (webdriverio devDependency) — no upstream fix exists (npm latest 2.0.1 is itself in range; advisory first_patched_version=null); archives are HTTPS browser binaries, not untrusted input; path removed by wdio 10 upgrade — tracked in #1769
GHSA-7pqw-9j4j-h8q3  # added 2026-09-11, re-justified 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo, re-verified 2026-10-09 by fix-649-audit (fleet) — extract-zip — same path and reasoning — tracked in #1769

# --- deepmerge-ts: webdriverio config merging — fix is a major outside its range ---
# Re-verified 2026-10-09: the fix is 8.0.0 (a major). Every wdio 9 consumer
# (@wdio/config, @wdio/runner, @wdio/utils, webdriver — all 9.27.0) declares
# `^7.0.3`, so a flat override would put an untested deepmerge-ts under
# WebdriverIO's core config merging. wdio 10's @wdio/utils@10.0.1 declares
# `^8.0.0` — the upstream-sanctioned fix path — but wdio 10 is itself a
# breaking harness major (Node >=22.19, Appium 3, Mocha 12, removed
# touchAction/executeAsync/uploadFile) with no CI coverage for our 6 desktop
# wdio specs. Tracked in #1769.
# Reachability: stack exhaustion when merging recursive object graphs. The
# only objects merged are WebdriverIO capability/config objects authored in
# this repo.
GHSA-ggr8-5vv4-36mx  # added 2026-09-11, re-justified 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo, re-verified 2026-10-09 by fix-649-audit (fleet) — deepmerge-ts (webdriverio devDependency config merging) — fix is a major outside every wdio 9 consumer's ^7.0.3 range; wdio 10 adopts ^8.0.0, upgrade tracked in #1769; merges only repo-authored config objects

# --- http-cache-semantics: astro (marketing site build, site/) — NO UPSTREAM FIX ---
# Re-verified 2026-10-09: GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp still covers
# `http-cache-semantics` <= 4.2.0 with first_patched_version=null on the
# GitHub advisory. 4.3.0 IS PUBLISHED AND IS NOT A FIX: diffing the 4.2.0 and
# 4.3.0 tarballs, index.js changes only a `Vary: *` matching bug, adds a
# status() accessor and touches JSDoc — the max-stale / security-zeroed logic
# the advisory cites (index.js L425-441, L603-623) is byte-identical. Because
# the advisory range is `<= 4.2.0`, bumping to 4.3.0 would silence
# `bun audit` without fixing anything. DO NOT bump this to silence the audit;
# wait for a real fix. astro@7.3.8 (current) still declares ^4.2.0.
# Reachability: one consumer, one call site — astro's build-time remote-asset
# cache (astro/dist/assets/build/remote.js). The flaw needs a shared
# multi-user cache serving requests; this is a single-tenant cache on the
# build machine, over URLs committed to this repo. The deployed static site
# on Cloudflare Pages ships no copy of this package and evaluates no
# max-stale at request time.
GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp  # added 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo, re-verified 2026-10-09 by fix-649-audit (fleet) — http-cache-semantics (astro, site/ build tool) — no upstream fix exists (advisory first_patched_version=null; 4.3.0 is NOT a fix, verified by source diff); build-time single-tenant cache, unreachable from any request — tracked in #1579

# --- braces: chokidar / micromatch dev+build tooling — NO UPSTREAM FIX ---
# Re-verified 2026-10-09: GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm still covers `braces` <= 3.0.3
# with first_patched_version=null, and npm `latest` IS 3.0.3 — the newest
# release is the vulnerable one, so no overrides floor can be written.
# Routing around it is also unavailable: chokidar@4 dropped braces/micromatch,
# but @tanstack/router-plugin (a direct dependency) declares chokidar@^3 and
# chokidar 4 removed glob support, so the major would break Vite route-file
# watching; and micromatch itself is at 4.0.8 still declaring braces ^3.0.3
# with no fix, so the shadcn / playwright-bdd / jest-message-util paths
# persist regardless.
# Reachability: every path is build-, dev- or test-time glob expansion over
# patterns written in this repository (Vite/TanStack route watching, Mocha and
# WebdriverIO spec discovery, shadcn CLI matching, playwright-bdd feature
# discovery, Jest message formatting). The DoS needs an attacker-supplied
# deeply-nested brace pattern; no consumer here is handed a pattern from a
# request or any untrusted source, and braces is absent from the worker's
# production closure and from every shipped client bundle.
GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm  # added 2026-10-06 by rhonda-rodododo, re-verified 2026-10-09 by fix-649-audit (fleet) — braces (chokidar via @tanstack/router-plugin/wdio/mocha; micromatch via shadcn/playwright-bdd/jest-message-util; astro) — no upstream fix exists (npm latest 3.0.3 is itself in range; advisory first_patched_version=null); build/dev/test-time glob patterns from this repo only — tracked in #1580
